verdict.rationale: Adyen's Protect risk management system is explicitly documented with 'Machine learning powered fraud detection using global transaction data' plus a 'rule builder interface' to 'Create, backtest, and label custom rules,' and Uplift adds AI-driven risk/cost/conversion recommendations — directly matching the ML scoring + custom rule story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of distinct block/review/allow rule outcomes and any independent/hands-on corroboration of rule-builder usability or fraud-score accuracy.
